summary: Acer Aspire 5 15 (Model: A515-53G9, Intel Core i7-1165G7, NVIDIA GeForce MX330, 16 GB DDR4 RAM) has inadequate cooling system leading to thermal throttling. The laptop's thermal design is not optimized for high-performance usage.
detected_fault: Thermal throttling due to inadequate cooling system
suggested_solution: Upgrade the cooling system and consider replacing the MX330 GPU with a more powerful option, such as an NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon RX 560X. Add more RAM (at least 32 GB) for improved multitasking and resource-intensive tasks.
